pages.text: $(item)HPV Vaccine$() — the classic shot against HPV infection. (Only takes one here.)
$(item)AIDS Vaccine$() — before any risky business, give yourself a shot of peace of mind.

$(item)Condom (BYT)$() — wear one beforehand for worry-free mating; it even keeps the partner's negative effects from infecting you.$(br2)$(#FF69B4)The condom is one of humanity's greatest inventions, meow!$()
$(item)Birth Control Pill$() — take this if you don't want babies anytime soon.
$(item)Sterilization Pills$() — the ultimate permanent contraceptive. No more worries... ever. Use with extreme caution!
$(item)Breeding Lock$() — attach it to someone who wants peace and they can no longer breed. «Not today. Really not today, meow.»
